description: Estimates an Ontario Workforce Priority Stream Expression of Interest score from a profile, with a factor-by-factor breakdown. Omitted fields score 0. Unofficial estimate.

canadianCredentials.description: Canadian post-secondary credentials: 0, 1 or 2 (2 = more than one)

category.description: Broad occupational category (first digit of the NOC code), 0 to 9

clb.description: Lowest CLB level across the four abilities in the first official language

earnings.description: Highest Canadian earnings in one year in the last 5 years, per CRA Notice of Assessment

monthsInOntario.description: Months of full-time (or part-time equivalent) work in Ontario

monthsInPosition.description: Months of full-time work in the job-offer position

pathway.description: Job offer in a TEER 0-3 occupation, job offer in a TEER 4-5 occupation, or self-employed physician

practiceMonths.description: Physicians only: months of cumulative practice in Ontario

region.description: Region of the job or practice location

secondLanguageClb6.description: CLB 6 or higher in all four abilities in the other official language

teer.description: TEER of the NOC code (second digit), 0 to 5

wage.description: Hourly wage of the job offer in CAD (job-offer pathways only)

name: calculate_oinp_score
title: Estimate an OWP Stream EOI score
